- Invalid task fields now produce clearer, command-specific error messages.

Add persistent task storage
commitResults.messageBody: Tasks were previously only saved in memory and lost when user exits program. This commit adds serialization and deserialization using JSONL format.

Add typed date and time support
commitResults.messageBody:
Deadlines and events currently store temporal values as arbitrary strings, which prevents validation, formatting, and date-based queries.
This commit adds the record TaskDate to represent a serialisable Date and Time for our app.

commitResults.messageBody: Users cannot search the task list without manually inspecting every task.\n\nAdd a case-insensitive substring search over task descriptions and display the matching tasks. Reject a missing keyword with a usage error so the command provides clear guidance instead of silently returning the complete task list.

commitResults.messageBody: The project previously required a manual javac source-file list for compilation. This commit adds the Gradle wrapper, Java 25 configuration, JUnit support, executable JAR packaging, and Gradle-based UI test compilation.

commitResults.messageBody: The application had no automated tests for date parsing or task search behavior. This commit adds coverage for valid and invalid TaskDate values and case-insensitive ordered TaskList searches.
